\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 156-159 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:UR-R164-first-pass-words-from-chapters-156-159}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a quilt and a carpet.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a festival, New Year, an era, every week, every year
  \item a place, a neighbourhood, a pavement, a town square, a canal
  \item a nation, a settlement, a port, a restaurant, a café
  \item so, since, if, even so, otherwise
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A festival? (\textbf{\ur{تہوار}}, \emph{tahvār}.) New Year? (\textbf{\ur{نیا} \ur{سال}}, \emph{nayā sāl}.) An era? (\textbf{\ur{زمانہ}}, \emph{zamānā}.) Every week? (\textbf{\ur{ہر} \ur{ہفتے}}, \emph{har hafte}.) Every year? (\textbf{\ur{ہر} \ur{سال}}, \emph{har sāl}.) A place? (\textbf{\ur{جگہ}}, \emph{jagah}.) A neighbourhood? (\textbf{\ur{محلہ}}, \emph{mohallā}.) A pavement? (\textbf{\ur{فٹ} \ur{پاتھ}}, \emph{fuṭpāth}.) A town square? (\textbf{\ur{چوک}}, \emph{chauk}.) A canal? (\textbf{\ur{نہر}}, \emph{nahar}.) A nation? (\textbf{\ur{قوم}}, \emph{qaum}.) A settlement? (\textbf{\ur{بستی}}, \emph{bastī}.) A port? (\textbf{\ur{بندرگاہ}}, \emph{bandargāh}.) A restaurant? (\textbf{\ur{ریسٹورنٹ}}, \emph{resṭorenṭ}.) A café? (\textbf{\ur{کیفے}}, \emph{kaife}.) So? (\textbf{\ur{اس} \ur{لیے}}, \emph{is liye}.) Since? (\textbf{\ur{چونکہ}}, \emph{chūṅki}.) If? (\textbf{\ur{اگر}}, \emph{agar}.) Even so? (\textbf{\ur{پھر} \ur{بھی}}, \emph{phir bhī}.) Otherwise? (\textbf{\ur{ورنہ}}, \emph{varnā}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 160-164 — a second pass}

\label{lesson:UR-R164-second-pass-words-from-chapters-160-164}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for kind and sensible.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item kind, sensible, foolish, lazy, hardworking
  \item safe, delicate, smooth; greasy, rough, round
  \item local, English, Pakistani, Indian, grey
  \item pointless, forced, free, pure, embarrassed
  \item luggage, a thing, furniture, a quilt, a carpet
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Kind? (\textbf{\ur{مہربان}}, \emph{mehrbān}.) Sensible? (\textbf{\ur{سمجھدار}}, \emph{samajhdār}.) Foolish? (\textbf{\ur{بیوقوف}}, \emph{bevaqūf}.) Lazy? (\textbf{\ur{سست}}, \emph{sust}.) Hardworking? (\textbf{\ur{محنتی}}, \emph{mehnatī}.) Safe? (\textbf{\ur{محفوظ}}, \emph{mahfūz}.) Delicate? (\textbf{\ur{نازک}}, \emph{nāzuk}.) Smooth; greasy? (\textbf{\ur{چکنا}}, \emph{chiknā}.) Rough? (\textbf{\ur{کھردرا}}, \emph{khurdurā}.) Round? (\textbf{\ur{گول}}, \emph{gol}.) Local? (\textbf{\ur{مقامی}}, \emph{maqāmī}.) English? (\textbf{\ur{انگریزی}}, \emph{angrezī}.) Pakistani? (\textbf{\ur{پاکستانی}}, \emph{pākistānī}.) Indian? (\textbf{\ur{ہندوستانی}}, \emph{hindustānī}.) Grey? (\textbf{\ur{سرمئی}}, \emph{surmaī}.) Pointless? (\textbf{\ur{فضول}}, \emph{fuzūl}.) Forced? (\textbf{\ur{مجبور}}, \emph{majbūr}.) Free? (\textbf{\ur{آزاد}}, \emph{āzād}.) Pure? (\textbf{\ur{پاک}}, \emph{pāk}.) Embarrassed? (\textbf{\ur{شرمندہ}}, \emph{sharmindā}.) Luggage? (\textbf{\ur{سامان}}, \emph{sāmān}.) A thing? (\textbf{\ur{چیز}}, \emph{chīz}.) Furniture? (\textbf{\ur{فرنیچر}}, \emph{farnīchar}.) A quilt? (\textbf{\ur{رضائی}}, \emph{razāī}.) A carpet? (\textbf{\ur{قالین}}, \emph{qālīn}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
